steps.label: Read the hold banner
steps.detail: Home or Settings → Payments. Note whether it says verify, bank, chargeback, or review.

steps.label: Owner email + spam
steps.detail: Only the store owner gets Risk/Payments mail (legal-mailer.shopify.com).

steps.label: Use the banner button
steps.detail: Complete account setup or View documents. Staff will get a permission toast.

steps.label: Reply on the same ticket
steps.detail: If it is a silent standard review, do not open a new chat. Reply on the email with the ticket number.

steps.label: Open Settings → Payments
steps.detail: Confirm the red “unable to accept payments” banner is on this page.

steps.label: Activate a primary card provider
steps.detail: Shopify Payments if offered; otherwise a live third-party card gateway. PayPal alone will not clear the banner.

steps.label: Confirm test mode is off
steps.detail: Manage → uncheck Test mode → Save.

steps.label: Incognito checkout
steps.detail: A card method must appear. Then a $1 real charge + refund.

steps.label: Payments → Manage
steps.detail: The homepage banner toggle is not enough.

steps.label: Uncheck Test mode and Save
steps.detail: Third-party: also replace sandbox keys.

steps.label: Send a new checkout
steps.detail: Abandoned checkouts created in test mode can keep failing.

steps.label: Draft order with their address
steps.detail: City, country, postal. Do not test with your warehouse address only.

steps.label: Country in exactly one zone
steps.detail: Settings → Shipping and delivery → Manage rates.

steps.label: Add a fallback flat rate
steps.detail: Stops a carrier API outage from zeroing checkout.

steps.label: Weight + shipping origin
steps.detail: Physical products need a weight. Inventory location must be a shipping origin.

steps.label: Duplicate the live theme
steps.detail: Never edit production first.

steps.label: Open the file in the red line
steps.detail: Usually sections/header.liquid or a section the editor cannot preview.

steps.label: Revert that file or close the tag
steps.detail: Version dropdown → last good save.

steps.label: If it started after an app, disable the embed
steps.detail: Theme editor → App embeds.

steps.label: When did it start?
steps.detail: New app, theme publish, or Shopify deploy.

steps.label: Disable the newest app embed
steps.detail: Customize → App embeds. Preview after each one.

steps.label: Preview a clean theme
steps.detail: If Dawn/preview is clean, it is theme or embed — not Payments.

steps.label: Update or uninstall the culprit
steps.detail: Settings → Apps. Prefer update; uninstall only if preview stays broken.
